candidates.title: Run production AI agents in n8n with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore harness
candidates.summary: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore harness is now generally available. Learn how to add it as an agent step in n8n workflows using a new open-source community node, and build agents with persistent memory, real tools, code execution, and VPC isolation — all from the n8n editor with no infrastructure or agent code.

candidates.title: Google Maps adds agentic features, including food ordering and hotel bookings
candidates.summary: The launch of these new features reflects Google’s ambitions to transform Google Maps from a navigation tool into an assistant that's capable of helping users complete real-world tasks.

candidates.title: How LendingTree built a multi-agent mortgage assistant on Amazon Bedrock
candidates.summary: Learn how LendingTree built a production multi-agent mortgage assistant on Amazon Bedrock. Three coordinated agents use LangGraph, the Model Context Protocol, and Amazon Nova models with built-in guardrails to deliver 24/7 personalized mortgage guidance while meeting strict financial-services compliance.

candidates.title: Meta launches Muse Code, an AI agent for large code bases
candidates.summary: Meta expanded its AI coding offerings with a new agent that, it promises, can handle complex tasks with complex software.

candidates.title: Working with the American Psychological Association on youth mental health and AI
candidates.summary: OpenAI and the American Psychological Association advance evidence-based guidance, resources, and safeguards for responsible AI use and youth mental health.

candidates.title: From asking to doing: How the world is putting ChatGPT to work
candidates.summary: New OpenAI Signals data shows how people use ChatGPT worldwide, with country-level insights on adoption, usage trends, and evolving behavior.
